text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today is the first day of the summer<n>camp, a period
of intensive race<n>training.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Can you hear them? The waves in<n>the distance...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not only is the sound relaxing, but the<n>breeze helps
to escape the heat.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Those who conquer summer emerge<n>victorious in
fall.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Our path to the Japan Cup has<n>already begun... I'll
be relying on your<n>guidance.
